hook.text: You watch someone cheat a stranger. You were not harmed. Yet you pay your own money to punish the cheater. Why?

buildup.text: Third-party punishment means bystanders who are unaffected personally still pay to punish norm violators.

discovery.text: Third-Party Punishment reveals the behavioral mechanism driving the outcome.

twist.text: The threat is often enough. Knowing bystanders will punish deters cheating even if punishment rarely happens.

climax.text: Third-party punishment is the foundation of law and social order. We all enforce fairness, not those directly harmed.

punchline.text: We punish cheaters even when we are not the victim. That is society.

quiz.question: Why is third-party punishment important for cooperation?
options: It deters cheating by showing norm violations will be punished by anyone
It only works in small communities
